title: How Sand Becomes a Glass Bottle

lines.say: How does sand become a bottle?
Sand, soda ash, limestone, and lots of crushed old glass.
Into the furnace. Fifteen fifty degrees Celsius.
lines.caption: 1,550 °C

lines.say: But how do you shape a river of fire?
At eleven hundred degrees, shears cut it into glowing lumps. One lump, one bottle.
lines.caption: 1,100 °C

lines.say: A puff of air makes a small, thick preform.
It flips upside down. A second blast inflates it to full size.
Done? No. Now it goes back into an oven.
Five eighty degrees Celsius, then cooled slowly, so it won't crack.
lines.caption: 580 °C

lines.say: Every bottle is checked. Rejects get crushed and melted again.
One machine can make over six hundred a minute.
lines.caption: 600+ A MINUTE
